analysis.analysis: What distinguishes this from the 2026-09-20 observation is only that it is the next day, and that identity is the datum. A panel regenerated fresh from retrieval would vary in wording; this one did not vary in a character, while the rank-1 organic snippet it sits above changed between the two days. So the panel is not being composed from the served set on each request -- the composition and the retrieval are decoupled, and the composition side is holding a cached or stabilized answer keyed to the string. G_RC is therefore not only near-maximal but static: the retrieved set moved and the composition did not follow it. The 'Show thread' affordance under the panel opens an AI Mode continuation; that continuation was taken and is seated as its own address on the AI Mode surface (crimson-hexagonal-archive-aimode-20260921), where the same panel is round 1.
analysis.d: THE SUBSTITUTION HOLDS ON THE NEXT DAY, CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER, WHILE THE ORGANIC SET BENEATH IT CHANGES. Asked the archive's own name, signed out, on 2026-09-21 the panel composes the same defunct analytics firm from the same four third-party sources as on 2026-09-20 -- one trillion posts, the 2018 Facebook suspension, Pew Research -- and offers the same two follow-ups about 'their data platform' and 'their merger and corporate history'.
